meta.title: Syrian National Hospital Management Platform | One Network for 14 Governorates
meta.description: A unified, secure hospital management platform connecting hospitals across all 14 Syrian governorates — one national patient record, cross-hospital referrals, AI-assisted diagnostics, and national health reporting.

overview.title: A single, connected system for national healthcare
overview.subtitle: The platform unifies hospitals, regional health authorities, and the ministry under one secure system — built around a single national patient identity that follows the patient wherever they receive care.

pillars.title: Unified patient record
pillars.description: Every patient has one national health identity (NHID). Their history follows them across hospitals — no fragmented, duplicated records.

pillars.title: Connected hospitals
pillars.description: Hospitals coordinate through structured, consent-based referrals, so patients move between facilities with their clinical context intact.

pillars.title: National oversight
pillars.description: Regional and ministry teams see live, aggregated insight across the whole network — without ever breaking hospital-level data isolation.

faq.title: Frequently asked questions
faq.subtitle: Answers to the questions hospitals and health authorities ask most.

items.q: Is this for a single hospital or the whole country?
items.a: Both. The platform is multi-tenant: each hospital runs its own day-to-day operations in isolation, while regional and ministry teams get a connected, national view across the whole network.

Data is isolated per hospital, access is role-based with least privilege, every action is audited, and sessions use hardened, rotating tokens. Cross-hospital access is only ever granted through an accepted referral.

items.q: Can hospitals share a patient's records?
items.a: Yes — safely. Each patient has one national identity, and when a hospital accepts a referral it gains consent-based access to that patient's relevant records across the network.
English, Arabic, and Turkish are supported throughout, including full right-to-left layout for Arabic.

items.q: Is the AI a medical diagnosis?
items.a: No. The AI provides decision support — screening, suggestions, and safety checks. Every result is reviewed by a qualified clinician and is not a substitute for professional diagnosis.

items.q: How do staff and patients sign in?
items.a: Staff and patients sign in through the secure login. Use the Login button in the navigation to access your account; patients land in the patient portal and staff in their role-specific dashboard.
